summary: Ran full backend regression (30 pytest cases, 100% pass) and Playwright smoke on frontend for SIES FinCore. Backend correctness verified: JWT + httpOnly cookies login (admin, finance, auditor, procurement), Executive Dashboard KPIs (Revenue 6.59 Cr, Expenditure 6.25 Cr, Net Surplus 33.61 L), Trial Balance balanced=true with total_debit==total_credit, journals per-entry balanced, Financial Statements, Ledger, Fees flow (list, defaulters, record payment success, idempotency duplicate, exceed-outstanding rejected with 400), Procurement (invoices, PO, GRN, vendors, 3-way match sheet), Finance (revenue/expenses/receivables/payables aging), Budgets, Audit logs & anomalies, RBAC (auditor POST /api/fees/payments returns 403), AI assistant (suggestions + ask returns non-empty answer with no em dash). Frontend: startup animation completes, login form appears, dashboard renders KPI cards with real INR values, KPI drilldown sheet (Revenue Breakdown) opens on click, sidebar exposes 14 modules with correct data-testid values, Accounting Engine tabs load with 'Balanced' text, Student Fee Ledger shows summary + table + drilldown sheet with Record Payment form, theme toggle works, Ctrl+K opens command palette. No em dash (U+2014) characters observed on Dashboard.

integration_issues.issue: After clicking sidebar-module-ai_assistant, [data-testid=ai-assistant-query-input] was not found within 30s. Backend /api/ai/ask works for admin. Please verify the AI Assistant page renders the input for non-admin roles that have ai_assistant view perm, or expose the input with the documented data-testid.

issues: FY selector displays 2025–26 using en dash (U+2013). Requirement only bans em dash (U+2014) so this is acceptable, but flagging for consistency.

action_items: Verify the AI Assistant page in the frontend exposes [data-testid=ai-assistant-query-input] and a submit button; when logged in as finance_manager the input did not appear within 30s (backend /api/ai/ask is confirmed working).

RBAC design check: NAV_VIEW in /app/frontend/src/lib/perms.js sets auditor='*', so the auditor sidebar shows all 14 modules including 'Administration'. Backend enforcement is fine, but review whether auditor should see Administration module in the sidebar per requirements.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_ai.py uses .with_model('openai', 'gpt-5.4'). Confirm this model id is valid in Emergent LLM proxy; if not, /api/ai/ask will 502. In this run it returned 200 so model is accepted.
auth.py: locked_until is refreshed on every failed attempt (line 108), which effectively extends the lock window on each new attempt. Consider setting locked_until only when count>=MAX_ATTEMPTS.
server.py adds CORSMiddleware AFTER include_router — Starlette middleware ordering still applies but conventionally middleware should be added before routes for clarity.

routes_fees.record_payment: audit is fired after DB writes, but there is no transaction — a partial failure (e.g. after post_journal but before payments.insert_one) could leave the journal without a payment record. Consider a compensating step or MongoDB transactions.
perms.js: auditor='*' contradicts 'auditor read-only, no admin modules'. Consider a whitelist that excludes 'administration'.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (login, dashboard, KPI drilldown, accounting balanced, fees drilldown + record-payment form, RBAC sidebar count, theme toggle, Ctrl+K all verified; AI Assistant input not observed for finance role)

seed_data_creation: None; used seeded demo data. Test payments used unique idempotency keys prefixed with TEST- and small amounts to preserve balances.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend routes are mounted directly under /api (no /accounting or /procurement sub-prefix). Correct paths: /api/trial-balance, /api/financial-statements, /api/journals, /api/journals/{no}, /api/accounts, /api/ledger?account_code=..., /api/vendors, /api/purchase-orders, /api/grn, /api/invoices, /api/invoices/{no}/match, /api/revenue, /api/expenses, /api/receivables/aging, /api/payables/aging, /api/dashboard, /api/analytics/kpis, /api/analytics/forecast. Login is JSON to /api/auth/login which sets httpOnly access_token+refresh_token cookies. AI assistant model is gpt-5.4 via Emergent LLM. Sidebar item id 'sidebar-module-ai_assistant' (underscore).
rca of the issue: AI Assistant frontend not verified for finance role — likely just a routing/render nuance since the sidebar link is exposed and backend returns 200 for /api/ai/ask. Main agent should confirm the page uses the documented data-testid on the input and submit button.
